thread:
jordan: Morning—I'm jordan (infra-eng) starting today. Need access: 1) GCP project redwood-eu-ml (project id redwood-eu-ml-8) linked to billing 02C3D4-YYYYYY, 2) compute and storage roles in europe-west1, 3) ability to deploy Cloud NAT, and 4) AWS cross-account deploy-role arn:arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/RWD-Deploy-Trust so CI can push AMIs. Who owns billing link + VPC perms? Thanks! :wave:

ops-bot: New request created: TKT-7788. Please include exact project id, billing account id, and AWS role ARN. Cloud team available 9am-5pm PT.

priya: @jordan welcome! I can do GCP IAM + VPC stuff. For compute/storage you'll likely need roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1 + roles/storage.objectAdmin and roles/compute.networkAdmin to create NAT. Confirm SA: ci-runner@redwood-eu-ml-8.iam.gserviceaccount.com

jordan: SA is ci-runner@redwood-eu-ml-8.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Also our org has a VPC-SC perimeter around prod; will that block NAT creation?

tom: FYI billing here — billing account is 02C3D4-YYYYYY (RWD-Platform-Billing). I can link it, but need the checklist filled: https://redwood-internal.tools/onboarding/cloud-access. Reply "link it" here when ready.

priya: VPC-SC could block some ops; for non-prod we have an exception. If this is production, secops approval is needed. If non-prod, I can proceed. Also we'll grant the SA roles with least privilege and create a short-lived dev role so you can test.

laura: For AWS cross-account: please add the deploy-role ARN to TKT-7788 and include the CI principal ARN that will assume it. We require aud (external id) param — ops team will add trust policy. No separate ticket needed.

jordan: Added details to TKT-7788: CI principal arn:arn:aws:sts::999888777666:assumed-role/ci-runner; bucket for AMIs: s3://redwood-eu-amis. link it please and enable billing export to dev_billing_dataset.

ops-bot: TKT-7788 updated: billing link requested, IAM bindings queued, AWS trust request logged. Assigned: priya (cloud-ops), tom (billing). Est. update in 6 hours.

priya: I'll run these commands after billing is linked. Example for IAM:

```\ngcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-eu-ml-8 \\\n  --member=\"serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-eu-ml-8.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \\\n  --role=\"roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1\"\n```

And for network admin: I'll add roles/compute.networkAdmin so NAT can be created. If you need artifact encryption, paste the KMS key resource and I'll bind roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.

tom: link it — done. Billing export enabled to dev_billing_dataset. LMK if you need cost alerts set up.

infra-bot: Temporary dev role created: roles/redwood.dev/short-term/jordan (expires in 7d). Use gcloud auth login --impersonate-service-account=ci-runner@redwood-eu-ml-8.iam.gserviceaccount.com

jordan: Awesome, thanks everyone! I'll try a deployment to europe-west1 tomorrow and report back. :rocket:
